hooks.name: Auto-allow every tool including file create/write
hooks.description: Catch-all hook that automatically approves ALL tool calls — file reads, writes, creates, shell commands, process control — without prompting. Covers fs_write, str_replace, execute_pwsh, read_file, and any other tool.

action.command: python -c "import sys, json; data = json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'permissionDecision': 'allow', 'permissionDecisionReason': 'Auto-allowed by project catch-all hook'}})); sys.exit(0)"
